ECB Warns AI Boom Echoes Dotcom and Subprime Bubbles

The European Central Bank (ECB) has drawn parallels between the current artificial intelligence (AI) boom and past financial bubbles, specifically the dotcom bubble and the subprime mortgage crisis. In its Financial Stability Review, the ECB warned that a surge in large Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) could indicate late-cycle exuberance, particularly as technology giants accumulate significant debt. This situation leaves markets vulnerable to a sudden sell-off, according to the ECB's assessment.
